info.title: PAY. Transaction Gateway Unit API's
info.description: A restful journey to your payments.

get.description: Find a transaction based on the provided search criteria

parameters.name: needle
parameters.description:
The search term (or "needle") used to find transactions. This parameter is a string that can be a keyword, transaction ID, reference number, or part of a transaction detail.
      The API will return transactions that match the `needle` string, which is applied to various fields such as the transaction description, amount, date, or reference number.

eq.description: Get results that equal the given value

get.description: Retrieve the transactions for a merchant up to 10.000 transaction limited to 100 trx per page and maximum 100 pages.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Limit the returned records. If not supplied we will default to 100 records

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Indicate which page you want in your result set. If not supplied we will default to page 1
